firstContext: 💛 You hold Mother's Ring. The winter the factory closed Niamh pressed this into your hand and said: fix what you can reach. She twisted it when she was thinking, which was always. You twist it now. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon.

w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: The System's messages have gotten careful around you. It chooses its words the way you choose footing on ice.
The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,2. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🌙 Raid — Thornfield came in the night from the northeast. They carried off ~1600 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
The garden: your untended Burdock drowned in weeds and died. (Six untended days. The garden keeps honest books.)

windowEndGuard: not-ready:Finish the current encounter before taking your seat.
auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Wanjiru Kamau ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
